tools.name: get_case_study
tools.description: Returns one real case study in full: facts, metrics and the page narrative as markdown. Get the slug from list_case_studies.

Use it to find the right page or post before reading it with get_blog_post, get_service or get_industry_playbook.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_services" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Returns the six service pillars and the eleven AI Agent Development capabilities, each with a one-line description and URL. Use it first to find the right servi…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_contact_options, list_services, list_industries, list_case_studies, get_blog_post, search_content · Private data: get_company_profile, get_contact_options · Public sink: get_contact_options, get_blog_post, search_content, estimate_customer_service_savings.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_contact_options, list_services, list_industries, list_case_studies, get_blog_post, search_content · Private data: get_company_profile, get_contact_options · Public sink: get_contact_options, get_blog_post, search_content, estimate_customer_service_savings

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
